items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: I should do it, I was bringing in Dud Bascomb and the other trumpet players in the band. I said no, let them take one too.

ctx.x: I have been that way all my life as far as I can remember back. If I believe in a person, I think if he has some- thing there he should have just as much chance as I have if I can do it, like all the fellows in my band.

Like, when I got to New York, certain people said that I should be taking this solo. I should do it, I was bringing in Dud Bascomb and the other trumpet players in the band. I said no, let them take one too. Let them play. If they can play a solo, whoever it is, let them feature.

If you've noticed, a lot of my records, I featured Bobby Johnson, after Dud, and all the rest of the names on there. They played too. But, if I, I just can't take nothing from nobody. If I know he's got that ability,

items.q: It says 'A musical divertisement in a satyric setting featuring Hawkins Orchestra with Wilbur Bascomb.'

ctx.x: Yeah. But, that was the first. We was nervous. We were shaking. We had to go through the action like we was playing. We had played it on record first, you know.
Right. It says 'A musical divertisement in a satyric setting featuring Hawkins Orchestra with Wilbur Bascomb.'
